Name: SKI
Tagline: Voice-first coding harness
Description: Talk to your coding agents and hear them talk back. SKI runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity and pi side by side on your Mac, and tells you the moment one needs you.

Name: telemetry.dev
Tagline: LLM observability for AI agents
Description: telemetry.dev shows each run of your AI agent as one trace. Each model call and tool call is a span with its duration, tokens, cost, and error. Prompts and evals use the same traces: change a prompt without a deploy, then run it on a dataset and compare the scores with production. Alerts tell you about errors, cost spikes, and agent loops. Connect with our TypeScript or Python SDK, or with the OpenTelemetry exporter that you already use.

Name: Specsight
Tagline: Product observability for teams shipping fast with AI
Description: Shipping fast with AI? Specsight turns code changes into a living product map, feature knowledge, and clear release updates. Keep Product, Sales, and Support in sync with what your software actually does and what changed.

Name: GitHub Copilot Fusion
Tagline: GitHub's AI coding agent that picks and combines models
Description: GitHub Copilot Fusion takes the guesswork out of choosing AI models for coding. Instead of picking one model, Fusion automatically routes each task to suitable models and combines them when needed. One model can write code while another reviews or improves it. Choose Standard, High, or Max effort to balance speed, quality, and cost. Available across GitHub Copilot plans in VS Code, Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, and JetBrains IDEs.

Name: Agnos
Tagline: Clean documents for AI, and see what was removed
Description: Agnos cleans PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and web pges before they go into an AI chatbot, a RAG knowlede base or training data. It removes repeated headersand footers, page numbers, cookie banners, boilerplae and duplicates, and keeps tables, code and numbers It names the rule behind every removal; keep a piec or switch its rule off. Exports JSONL chunks, cleand text or training data. Runs on your Windows PC; nohing is uploaded. From the Microsoft Store: 14 days ree, then $99 once.

Name: Backenly
Tagline: The autonomous backend for AI coding agents
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub, Database
Description: Backenly is an autonomous backend platform built for coding agents. Your agent builds the backend over MCP, from Postgres to sign-in, storage, functions and realtime. Then it maintains itself: every minute a self-healing loop repairs missing indexes, RLS gaps and dead realtime triggers, verifying each fix live. As your app grows, it restructures its own schema once you approve. Risky changes wait for you, and every change is versioned with rollback.

Name: Knucklebop
Tagline: tap your palm rest to control your Mac
Description: Tap twice to mute your mic in any meeting. Three times to play music. Four for a menu of anything.

Name: LumaFold: Screen Light
Tagline: Makeup Mirror & Color Effects for iPhone Duo
Description: Make your iPhone Duo screen a creative studio with adjustable screen lighting, a live makeup mirror, color animations, and personal photo displays. LumaFold lets you use two screen areas differently. Light your face while checking your makeup, pair two colors for a creative shot, or combine a favorite photo with a handwritten message. LIGHT FOR YOUR BEAUTY ROUTINE Use the live camera mirror on one side and adjustable light on the other.

Name: WinnerAdSpy
Tagline: Turn competitor ad insights into winning app campaigns
Description: Winneradspy is an ad creative intelligence platform built specifically for mobile app and game marketers. Explore 20M+ ad creatives across 200K+ apps, uncover winning hooks, visuals, messaging and CTAs, and track competitor campaigns with real-time alerts. Unlike generic ad spy tools, it scores creatives as Winner, Loser or Learning, helping UA managers, growth teams and agencies understand what works and build better campaigns. Query ad insights through ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini via MCP.

Name: Mo
Tagline: A little character on your Mac who does 232 tasks for you
Description: Mo lives on your Mac screen and does the work for you: files, PDFs, photos, email, calendar, settings, routines and more, 232 tasks with no other app. Talk or type, get answers as cards, undo anything. Private, local models or your key. $19.99 once.

Name: Hemmed
Tagline: Hide Mac menu bar clutter and pin individual actions
Description: Native macOS app that hides menu bar icons behind one item, rescues icons stuck behind the notch, pins menu commands to hotkeys, keeps new menu bar apps hidden, flags battery-hungry hidden apps, and syncs your layout across your Macs with iCloud.

Name: ChainPoints
Tagline: Flight Prices in Your Points, on Google Flights
Description: ChainPoints is a free Chrome extension that shows you the cheapest way to book flights with your credit card points, live on Google Flights fare.

Name: Godwit
Tagline: An open-source, AI-native email client
Description: Godwit is an open-source desktop email client for any IMAP/SMTP account, with an AI assistant, Wit, that reads, summarizes, translates and drafts mail with the model you choose.

Name: Secret Key
Tagline: Let your family unlock your passwords if you can't
Description: Open-source, self-hosted emergency access for your password database. Split the master password into pieces for people you trust (e.g. any 3 of 5 unlock it). Access needs SMS verification and a 48-hour delay you can cancel with one click.

Name: BaseTab AI
Tagline: Turn your new tab into an AI-powered workspace
Description: BaseTab turns your browser's empty new tab into a dashboard you arrange yourself. Drag in 30+ widgets: notes, to-dos, Kanban, Pomodoro, bookmarks, weather, Google Calendar, Gmail, and chat with Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini. Missing a widget? Describe it in plain words and AI builds it for you. Keep separate workspaces for work and life, share one with your team, and pick a background that feels like home. Free forever, works without an account, and asks for site access only when a widget needs it.

Name: Pluto Door
Tagline: SSH client with an AI agent and a desktop for every server
Description: This launch adds Ori, an AI agent that reads your servers, finds what's wrong and explains it in plain English. When something needs to change, you see every command first and nothing runs until you approve; every edited file can be undone. Pluto XOS turns each server into a desktop with 15 apps, Hangar installs software in one click, and scheduled checks notify you before small problems grow. Works with AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Your servers and keys stay on your Mac. Free for 14 days.

Name: Seqora
Tagline: Design your schema on a canvas. Seqora writes the SQL.
Description: A desktop database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB and SQLite. Change tables on an ER canvas and Seqora writes the SQL. Every index, constraint, trigger and function gets its own page with size, usage and health. Visual EXPLAIN shows the plan step by step with measured timings. macOS and Windows, no account.

Name: SpaceO
Tagline: Give AI agents their own screen on your Mac
Description: Give AI agents a separate display for real Mac apps while you keep working. Connect through MCP or the CLI, watch sessions in the Viewer, and take over when an agent needs help. Supports native apps and Chromium. Free and MIT licensed; Apple Silicon, macOS 14+. Attention isolation, not a security sandbox: apps run as your macOS user. Runtime support depends on your macOS build.

Name: AC Bridge
Tagline: Your smart lights show when Claude Code or Codex needs you.
Topics: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Home Automation
Description: AC Bridge turns the smart lights and plugs you already own into ambient status for Claude Code and Codex. See at a glance whether your agent is working, blocked or done, and let Claude Code or Codex drive the devices you have connected, as a step in a task. Works with Hue, Govee, WLED, LIFX, Nanoleaf and more, plus Home Assistant.

Name: CubbyPad
Tagline: Launchpad is back on macOS 26, and it's smarter
Description: Apple removed Launchpad in macOS 26. CubbyPad brings back the full-screen app grid: pages, folders you arrange, F4, hot corners and the trackpad pinch. Then it goes further: a search bar that does maths, opens System Settings pages and runs your Shortcuts; Apple Intelligence that sorts your apps into folders on your Mac; and a row of the apps you use at this time of day. One-time purchase for 2 Macs, in 20 languages.
